evidence: Every one of the five injected prompts and all 52 criterion descriptions describe HireOps only. (1) Credentials: app_context.md:8-19 lists exactly the 10 accounts and password Hireops!2026 that instruction.md:17 and hireops_rules.md section 1 state; seed users USR-REC1..USR-CAN3 have the same names/emails/roles (Rafael Costa, Mei Lin, Farah Nasser recruiters; Ingrid Sorensen, Bill Okafor, Yuki Tanaka hiring_manager; Aud Halvorsen observer; Noor Haddad, Tomas Varga, Lena Fischer candidates). Prompts/criteria use only these people; a capitalised-name sweep of all prompt.md/judge.toml/app_context.md found only HireOps people, seeded jobs and seeded candidate names. (2) Screens: app_context.md:23-25 names Board (Applied, Screen, Interview, Offer, Hired, Rejected), Conversations, Activity and candidate applications/conversations, matching instruction.md:11 and the seed 'stages' array; visual prompt.md:14 reviews exactly Board, card details, Conversations, Activity and candidate view, and states 'No phone layout or theme switching is required', matching instruction.md:11. (3) Entities/seed facts re-derived from seed_data.json: three jobs (Platform Engineer/Infrastructure/Ingrid, Data Analyst/Finance Systems/Bill, Product Designer/Design/Yuki) match app_context.md:29; Noor's Platform Engineer conversation APP-101 has 120 messages (app_context.md:29-30); functional prompt.md:25 and hro_restart seeded order Applied 'Greta Lindqvist, Ade Bello, Marco Rossi' and Screen 'Priya Nair, Samuel Ortiz' match JOB-PLAT positions 1-3/1-2; the note 'Strong systems answers; weaker on incident follow-up.' matches notes[0] on APP-101 (Noor's card); Lena's unread 1 (prompt.md:25, hro_unread_counts) is correct: APP-301 has 3 messages, Lena's read_count=2, message 3 is from USR-REC3; Tomas's 'seeded Data Analyst conversation' exists (APP-201); candidate wording in hro_candidate_view equals candidate_status_labels; page size 30 in hro_thread_latest/earlier equals thread_page_size. Protocol role facts are internally consistent (J1 manager Ingrid, J2 manager Bill set in S; N, R, T, U and hro_thread_access/hro_seen/hro_notes/hro_mgr_* use them correctly). Every cross-referenced criterion id (hro_activity_refusals, hro_candidate_linked, hro_restart, hro_bulk_places, hro_undo_full, hro_bulk_move, hro_undo_conflict, hro_msg_compose, hro_candidate_private, hro_msg_exchange, hro_pol_session_resume) exists. (4) Deliverable: every prompt opens http://localhost:3000, matching instruction.md:13 port 3000 and app_context URL; no prompt names a route, selector or field the brief does not (app_context.md:33-34). Polish prompt.md:16 'Never use Lena Fischer's conversation' keeps Functional's Z read of Lena's starting unread count valid. No residue (other product names, foreign account lists, other data shapes, TODO/placeholder text) found by grep. Weak-app probe: a different-product or wrong-seed app would fail these HireOps-specific checks rather than pass via stale text; conforming-alternative probe: an app with different routes/labels is not penalised because prompts defer to visible UI. Only cosmetic observation (P3, no grading impact, not residue from other work): functional prompt.md:25 says 'do not sign in as Lena again before K', but protocol K (prompt.md:43) signs in only Noor and Tomas, so 'before K' is a vestigial qualifier; it reads in effect as 'do not sign in as Lena again' and no criterion depends on it. This is a static source review; no judge run was needed or claimed for this row, and it does not attest any Oracle, model or portal score.
